title: pentacalia disciformis
intro: Pentacalia disciformis, commonly known as the disc-shaped pentacalia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. It is reported to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, fever, and infection. The bioactive constituents of Pentacalia disciformis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
